title: [HLS] Short looping streams re-request segments because HLS playback is not disk-cached by default
body_html:
Problem

AVPlayer requests the same HLS media again on later loops.

Evidence level

Apple Confirmed.

Solution / Guideline

Use an explicit persistence path when persistent reuse is required.

Verification

Compare remote HLS and downloaded HLS.

title: [FairPlay] SDK 26 rejects SPC when certificate-bundle credentials are mismatched or unreadable
body_html:
Problem

SPC generation fails with invalid certificate bundle credentials.

Investigation

Separate certificate parsing from key-session state.

Verification

Validate the bundle and credentials independently.
